parameters.content:
## Extract Chrome Extension Developer Trader Emails, Manifest Permissions & Bug Reviews
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Chrome Web Store Scraper: Extensions, Trader Emails, Manifest & Reviews](https://apify.com/storeintel/chrome-web-store-scraper)

Scrape Chrome Web Store extensions via Google batchexecute RPC to extract verified EU DSA trader support emails, physical addresses, active install counts, manifest.json permissions, and user bug reports.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [Chrome Extension Developer Email, Trader Address & SaaS Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/chrome-extension-developer-email-trader-lead-scraper)
- [Chrome Extension User Reviews, Bug Reports & Churn Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/chrome-extension-reviews-bug-churn-scraper)
- [Chrome Extension Manifest V3 Permissions & Security Auditor](https://apify.com/storeintel/chrome-extension-manifest-permissions-security-auditor)
